Descartes/positivity give unique even-length threshold; characteristic roots prove monotonicity and 2-3log(3/2)/n correction. Code independently checks identity for n=4..11. No finite experiment is used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: A natural minimal equilibrium hard-core graph yields the first change in ordinary pair-occupation covariance as common activity varies. Exact five-vertex uniqueness is a meaningful structural boundary, supplemented by a parity law and analytic crossover thresholds in an infinite fan family. The result explains competing hub exclusion and path recurrence, rather than merely recomputing a known polynomial table.
